name: Basic Walk
description: Ground-based locomotion with configurable speed and acceleration. Movement CONTINUES while a direction is held rather than advancing once per press, because `input.moveDirection` reports whether the key is still down and a body that ignores that makes the player tap to walk. It also accepts `input.faceDirection`, which turns without moving — the aim half of a twin-stick or the look half of a shoulder-button strafe, and the thing a player needs when the swing scans the way they are pointed and they do not want to step into what they are hitting.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: startX
inputs.description: Where the body begins along X, in tiles. Null means the middle of the board. A region entered by walking off a neighbour should begin at the border it was entered THROUGH, not at the centre, or every crossing teleports the player away from the place they were walking toward.

inputs.name: startY
inputs.description: The same along Y. Null means the middle.

outputs.name: isMoving
outputs.description: Whether the character is currently moving
